headline: North American Morning Briefing :  Futures Fall; Investors Await Key Economic Data
summary: Stock futures pointed to a lower open on Monday as concerns persisted over the health of the U.S. economy and over AI disruption and possible over-investment. Investors were awaiting key economic data.
why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main gauge of American equity performance. Futures indicate expected opening direction for the cash index.
why_moved: Investors remain concerned about the underlying health of the US economy and about AI-related disruption and over-investment. Upcoming economic data is also awaited.
